scientific_integrity: The result is proved combinatorially for every finite projective plane satisfying the axioms. Finite exhaustive and witness-replay programs provide examples and consistency checks, not a substitute for the universal proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite projective plane of order at least two, uses ordinary geodetic intervals over all shortest paths, and applies endpoint-wise simultaneous exchanges. No assertion of plane existence for arbitrary orders or extension to arbitrary designs is made; unindexed related work remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Geodetic bases of finite projective-plane incidence graphs: flag rigidity and a sharp simultaneous-exchange threshold
